perks.name: Ionic Overclock
perks.description: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
perks.exact:
While Amplified:
(Linear) Fusion Rifles and Heat Weapons are granted +? Handling and +? Reload Speed.

perks.name: Shock and Clear
perks.description: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Jolt Kill or a Jolted Enemy Kill:
Creates an Ionic Trace.

item.name: Void Resistance
item.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
item.exact:
15% | 25% | 30% Damage Resist against Combatants.

Elemental Mods reduce Mod-Matching Elemental damage.
Sniper reduces damage from >30 metres.
Melee reduces damage from <5 metres.
Concussive Dampener reduces AoE/Blast/Explosive Damage.

Different Resist Mods, as well as other sources of Resist all stack multiplicatively with each other.
